summary: Approved as a strong modernist event-poster example: QUIET SIGNALS, SOUND DESIGN LAB, and SEPT 14 are all correctly rendered and legible; the white speaker cone is coherent; the black grid, restrained yellow accent, generous margins, and disciplined hierarchy form a polished unified graphic system.
knownLimitations: The speaker is rendered as a dimensional product object rather than a completely flat architectural drawing.
The poster is photographed against a dark surround, so the final asset includes presentation context around the white sheet.
